## Gym Buddy v0.1.0-beta.1 — first Android beta (test build)

This is the first Android build of Gym Buddy. It is a **pre-release for testers**.

### Install
1. Download `GymBuddy-0.1.0-beta.1-debug-signed.apk` below on your Android phone (Android 7.0 or newer).
2. Open it. If Android asks, allow your browser or file manager to "install unknown apps".
3. Optional: check the file against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

**Signing:** the APK is signed with a **debug key** generated by the CI runner. It is not a Play Store build. A future beta will have a different signature, so **uninstall this version before installing the next one**. Your account data is stored in the cloud and is not lost; only data saved on the phone while offline and not yet synced would be lost.

### What's in it
- Workout planner (AI), workout notebook (sets: working, warm-up, bodyweight, drop; warm-up generator)
- Calorie calculator (Mifflin-St Jeor + macros, computed on the phone) with AI advice
- Body-fat calculator (US Navy method, ACE category) with AI advice
- Meal analyzer from a camera or gallery photo or from a text description (AI)
- AI Buddy chat with nutrition and exercise cards; save suggested programs to the notebook
- Water tracker: goal, streak, weekly and 30-day charts, AI photo estimate, **native reminders** (08:00–22:00, also when the app is closed)
- Sign up / log in with e-mail, password reset, data synced to your account (Supabase); edits made offline are uploaded when you are back online

### Tested on an Android 16 emulator (Pixel profile)
Login, cloud sync, offline edit + later upload, cold restart (session kept), navigation and back button, camera and gallery, notification permission (allow and deny), reminders scheduled, AI chat in the app.
All AI tasks were also tested against the live backend: meal from text and photo, water from photo, calorie and body-fat advice, chat, workout plan, workout parsing.
**Not tested on a physical device.**

### Known issues
- **Exercise illustrations are not generated**: the Gemini image models return a quota error on the current (free) API key, so the planner shows a placeholder image. Everything else in the planner works.
- E-mail confirmation and password-reset links only open the app if the redirect URL is configured in Supabase. Otherwise the link confirms the account in the browser; then log in in the app.
- Google sign-in is not available yet.
- Reminders use inexact alarms and may arrive a few minutes late. Delivery of a reminder was not observed during testing; only scheduling was checked.
- The free Supabase plan pauses the backend after about 7 days without use; login and sync fail until it is resumed.
- Accounts from the old Firebase-based web app are not migrated (cloud sync never worked there). Please sign up again.
- The UI is Turkish only.
